result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane residential street with row houses but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. Pedestrians face significant exposure due to long crossing distances across multiple lanes without marked crosswalks, signals, or refuge areas.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without any marked crossing or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can hide pedestrians, especially children, from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the far curb in front of the row houses

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street environment provides continuous sidewalks but lacks marked crossings and traffic calming, creating a long, unprotected crossing distance. The presence of a painted bike lane and utility pole obstructions on the sidewalk further complicates the pedestrian experience.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated pedestrian crossings are visible for a significant stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed within the sidewalk path, narrowing the accessible width.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street corner with a wide concrete sidewalk but a complete lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While the narrow street width suggests lower traffic speeds, the absence of marked crosswalks and traffic control devices increases risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Undefined crossing point
hazards.description: The transition from the wide sidewalk area to the roadway lacks clear definition or ADA-compliant ramps.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the corner to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks in good condition but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Parked vehicles near the intersection create significant visual obstructions, and the wide roadway lacks traffic calming measures to protect pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A white van is parked immediately at the corner, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground sidewalk corner

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and curb ramps, making it difficult and unsafe for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to prevent parking near the corner, improve sightlines, and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with tactile warning surfaces to ensure accessibility for all users.
